tasks.label: Pico: Build + flash
tasks.detail: Build the firmware, then load it onto the Pico over USB (no BOOTSEL needed once it runs this firmware).
tasks.command: cmake -S firmware -B firmware/build && cmake --build firmware/build --target flash

tasks.label: Pico: Build
tasks.detail: firmware/build/synth.uf2, with the synth from synth/ and the page from web/.

tasks.label: Pico: Serial log
tasks.detail: The Pico's serial port: the page's lines and its log lines (# ...). Ctrl-A K to leave.

tasks.label: Pico: Trace a slow block
tasks.detail: Record until a block takes more than 80% of its time, then read it out: a Perfetto file in firmware/build/traces, and the slowest blocks. Play or move knobs meanwhile; close the page's USB serial first.

tasks.label: Pico: Trace 1000 blocks, playing notes
tasks.detail: A test that repeats: notes through the serial port while it records 1000 blocks (1.3 s).

tasks.label: Pico: Build + flash with synth trace points
tasks.detail: TRACE_DSP: stamps per voice and per pass inside the synth's render too (they cost a little: compare loads with the normal build).
tasks.command: cmake -S firmware -B firmware/build -DTRACE_DSP=ON && cmake --build firmware/build --target flash

tasks.label: Checks
tasks.detail: The desktop checks: MIDI, events, the page's lines, WebSocket, parameter tables, the synth.

tasks.label: Parameters: Generate
tasks.detail: params/parameters.json into the plugin's, the Pico's and the page's tables (every build does this too).

tasks.label: Plugin: Build (CLAP)
tasks.command: cmake -S synth -B synth/build -G Ninja && cmake --build synth/build

tasks.label: Plugin: Install (CLAP)
tasks.detail: Copy the CLAP to ~/Library/Audio/Plug-Ins/CLAP, for DAWs.

tasks.label: Plugin: Open in clap-host
tasks.detail: Build the CLAP, then play it in clap-host: audio on, live MIDI, its page in a window. Type host commands in the terminal (help); closing the terminal quits.

tasks.label: Plugin: Build (WCLAP)
tasks.detail: The plugin as a WCLAP, for browser DAWs: synth/build-wclap/PICOH-101.wclap.tar.gz.

tasks.label: Browser: Serve
tasks.detail: web/ on http://127.0.0.1:8460, for the page with the Pico on USB.
tasks.command: cd web && { [ -d node_modules ] || npm ci --no-audit --no-fund; } && npm run build --silent && cd .. && python3 tools/serve.py 8460

tasks.label: App: Run (macOS)
tasks.detail: The app, with the Pico on USB. PICOH_LOG_LINES=1 prints every line.

tasks.label: App: Install on iPhone
tasks.detail: Build for a connected, paired iPhone and install it (tauri.conf.json has the team).
tasks.command: cd app && PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH npx tauri ios build --debug && xcrun devicectl device install app --device "$(xcrun devicectl list devices | awk '/available \(paired\)/ && /iPhone/ {print $3; exit}')" gen/apple/build/arm64/PICOH-101.ipa

tasks.label: Page: Watch TypeScript
tasks.detail: Recompiles web/src into web/dist on every save.
